command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
git fetch origin main --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "fetch main failed" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne "591ecbad86a133812fa27521ca771aaba15e2ffe") { throw "main moved" }

$before="C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\filter-preset-before.png"
$after="C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\filter-preset-after.png"
if (-not (Test-Path $before) -or -not (Test-Path $after)) { throw "visual evidence missing" }

$evidence="C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\remote-evidence"
if (Test-Path $evidence) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $evidence }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $evidence | Out-Null
Copy-Item $before (Join-Path $evidence "filter-preset-before.png")
Copy-Item $after (Join-Path $evidence "filter-preset-after.png")
@"
feature=filter-presets
main=591ecbad86a133812fa27521ca771aaba15e2ffe
validated_product_tree=14771ce7a16afd36fad23cfd738238b642343f48
validated_gui_revision=ae1085c7d995ec7ba97774d8b0d1d95cfaa1e7e6
gui_run=37169304880
"@ | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 (Join-Path $evidence "manifest.txt")

Write-Host "FILTER_PRESET_EVIDENCE_READY"
